title: Demand-shaped math stages with complete native token transport
question: Can session-scoped demand-shaped math stages share parsing and retain the independent historical extraction/scope meanings through actual spawned transport?
method: Use explicit retained-content/readings/extraction/scoped session products and parent views reusing their inputs. Real spawn checks inspect all eight Token fields at every nested leaf in both directions, independent x=1 source bounds, complete direct/staged Normal extraction, unchanged frozen scope/printer expectations, omitted work, reuse and exception settlement. A native multiprocessing-only reducer repairs Lark token end-position loss; a lightweight initializer preserves lifecycle budgets.
commands:
PYTHONPATH=python/corpus-structure/tests uv run python - <<'PYDIAGNOSTIC' > build/test-receipts/tr02-math-token-transport-diagnostic.log 2>&1
import pickle
from math_support import read_page, extract_readings, scope_extraction
from corpus_structure.methods.math.context import standing_context
page=read_page('special/Normal.html')
values,extraction=extract_readings(page.readings)
direct=scope_extraction((page,values,extraction))
transported=pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(page.readings))
values_after,extraction_after=extract_readings(transported)
scoped_after=scope_extraction((page,values_after,extraction_after))
parts=[s for s in page.content.document.walk() if s.start==11565 and s.end==11826]
print('DIRECT', [(s.segment.start,s.segment.end) for s in standing_context(page.content,page.page,direct,parts)])
print('TRANSPORTED', [(s.segment.start,s.segment.end) for s in standing_context(page.content,page.page,scoped_after,parts)])
print('RELATIONS',len(extraction.relations),len(extraction_after.relations))
print('VALUES_SAME',values==values_after)
print('MENTIONS_SAME',extraction.mentions==extraction_after.mentions)
print('RELATION_DIFFERENCES',set(extraction.relations)-set(extraction_after.relations))
PYDIAGNOSTIC

conclusion: Tested 2026-11-05: 28 bounded controls passed. Session products reuse reading work and parent content; spawned workers return only new stage products. Complete native token position transport preserves direct Normal relations and all original frozen scope/printer meanings. Existing bounded submission, per-active-job deadlines, page diagnostics, spawn/main-thread execution, interruption and child settlement remain. Direct analyse_all still composes the same stages inside one whole-page job. Earlier failures and the interrupted initializer attempt are retained; the diagnostic itself failed at an optional unhashable-set print after completing the decisive comparisons. This record establishes focused functional behavior, not full-plan qualification or a speed/capacity claim.
